description: Implementation of top-down splay trees with size maintenance, including splay, insert, and delete operations.

methods.name: splaytree_splay_nonnull
methods.description: Performs top-down splaying to bring the key i to the root or the closest node.

methods.name: splaytree_insert_splayed
methods.description: Inserts a new node with key i into an already splayed tree.

methods.name: splaytree_insert
methods.description: Inserts a key into the tree if not already present, splaying the tree first.

methods.name: splaytree_delete_splayed_node
methods.description: Deletes the root node of a splayed tree.

methods.name: splaytree_delete
methods.description: Deletes a node with key i from the tree if it exists.
